## Reusable multi-sheet XLSX writer
n8n's Convert to File node writes one sheet only. This utility writes a real .xlsx with several sheets, styles, frozen header, filters and money formats. No external libraries, so it runs on any n8n instance.

**Input** `{ fileName, sheets: [{ name, colWidths, freezeRows, autoFilter, rows }] }`
A cell is a value or `{ v, s }`, where `s` is a style: title, bold, header, cell, money, review, wrap, muted...

**Output** binary `data`
